name: audio FPAA ASIC for Wafer Space run 3

mentions.name: audio FPAA ASIC for Wafer Space run 3
mentions.description: An audio FPAA (field-programmable analog array) ASIC being developed by Archit3ch for the Wafer Space run 3 tapeout. Work is ongoing to validate the design blocks before the run's deadline; the author hopes for test results on 2nd-run chips that use only 2 edges on the pad ring, which would enable significant area savings.
mentions.problem: The Wafer Space run 3 deadline is fast approaching and many design blocks are only partially validated. The author is also awaiting tested chips from the 2nd run that use only 2 edges on the pad ring, which would enable significant area savings.
mentions.author: Archit3ch
